content: विकॢप् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To doubt, be doubtful; कथंचिन्न विकल्पन्ते विद्वद्भिश्चिन्तिता नयाः <ls>Pt. 1. 339</ls>. .²2 To be optional. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To doubt, question; एवं कृष्णसखः कृष्णो भ्रात्रा राज्ञा विकल्पितः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 15. 1</ls>. .²2 To consider, reflect upon; सखीनियोगोऽपि विकल्प्यते <ls>Ś. 3</ls>. .²3 To presume, conjecture. .²4 To prepare or arrange differently. .²5 To make, form. .²6 To exchange. .²7 To admit as optional. .²8 To state a dilemma. .²9 To reflect upon.
